title: CactusOverheadGrowth
description: It’s a plugin that allows your cactus to grow anywhere example even if put a block on top of it will still grow
body:
**Enhanced Cactus Growth for Skyblock Farms**
Cactus farms are one of the most popular money-making methods on Skyblock servers — but building them inside structures or compact layouts is often frustrating. Normally, cactus breaks itself whenever a block is placed next to or above it, making advanced designs difficult and slowing down farm construction.
This plugin solves that problem by allowing cactus to grow even when a block is directly above it, preventing unwanted breakage and giving players the freedom to build compact, protected, or fully enclosed cactus farms without restrictions.
Whether you're optimizing Skyblock economy, speeding up farm building, or enabling creative structural designs, this plugin boosts convenience and efficiency for both players and server owners.
Perfect for:
Skyblock servers 
• Automated money farms • Compact builds • Protected farming structures
